title: Search multiple locations for required objects
description: Use when a task requires collecting multiple instances of the same object type.
content: When searching for multiple identical objects, do not stop after finding the first one; continue checking other plausible locations such as counters, shelves, and fixtures. If a location appears empty on arrival, revisit it later or check nearby surfaces, as objects may be found in unexpected places.

title: Retry failed take actions after examining the location
description: Use when a take action fails with "Nothing happens" despite the object being visible.
content: If taking an object fails, examine the surface or container to confirm the object is still present, then retry the take action. A failed take may be transient, and retrying after re-examining can succeed.

title: Move only the currently held object to the target container
description: Use when placing multiple objects into a container, especially after one object has already been moved.
content: After moving one object to a container, do not attempt to move that same object again; instead, move the newly acquired object. Ensure the action references the object currently in your inventory to avoid "Nothing happens" errors.

title: Locate target objects by examining containers
description: Use when the target object is not visible on surfaces or in the initial room.
content: When searching for a small object like a soapbar, systematically examine storage containers such as drawers and cabinets rather than repeatedly revisiting the same empty locations. The target object may be hidden inside a closed or unexamined container.

title: Clean objects at a sink basin
description: Use when the task requires cleaning an object before placing it elsewhere.
content: After picking up the object to be cleaned, go to a sink basin and use the "clean [object] with [sinkbasin]" action. The sink basin does not need to contain any visible items for the cleaning action to succeed.

title: Open cabinets before placing items inside
description: Use when the destination container is closed.
content: Before moving an object into a cabinet, check whether the cabinet is open. If it is closed, use the "open [cabinet]" action first, then move the object into the open cabinet.
